text.en: Pet owners consistently commend groomers Sarah and Tania for their joyful, welcoming demeanor and clear communication before appointments. Many clients appreciate their willingness to accommodate emergency grooming requests. One critical reviewer noted severe dissatisfaction after an accidental grooming nick was not disclosed.

Reviewers note that the staff show patience and gentle handling with nervous pups, senior pets, and difficult nail trims. Dogs are described as returning home relaxed and content after styling sessions. However, one owner reported their pet was injured during a rushed session and required subsequent veterinary attention.

Clients frequently express satisfaction with their dogs haircuts, describing excellent summer cuts, neat nail trimming, and adorable styling. Pets leave the salon smelling fresh and looking clean. In contrast, one unhappy customer felt the styling on their dog was rushed and poorly executed.

q.en: Do the groomers handle nervous or reactive dogs?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently mention that groomers are gentle and patient with anxious pets and difficult nail trims.

q.en: Can appointments be booked on short notice?

a.en: Reviewers note that staff have accommodated urgent grooming needs and fitted pets into busy schedules when possible.

q.en: Where is The Canine Palace located?

a.en: The salon is located in Toronto and features a clean, welcoming environment for grooming visits.
